author: piratewithgun
body:
i just got banned for trigger bot and i dont even know what that is?!

can i talk to someone about this?? i screen shared this morning with tazz after a scrim to prove i dont hack because people were reporting me

EDIT:

I have decided to rewrite my appeal because I wrote the first one in a state of fury immediately after being banned. I am not angry with the mods, but I am genuinely surprised about the infraction. 

If I am being called a hacker in-game, I normally find it funny and just take it as a compliment, but being falsely permanently-banned on my favourite server is a completely different story and is certainly not funny. 

Since receiving the ban, I have learned a little bit about hacks in order to understand what I am being accused of. There are many reasons as to why I would never consider installing hacks. Firstly, it ruins the fun for everyone! But equally as important to me is that I would never risk getting Cacal disqualified on my behalf. 

It is all very well listing reasons about why I am strongly against hacking, but at the end of the day I guess it comes down to the proof. I understand that mods have acquired evidence against me, but I can't possibly understand how you can use any clips to prove that I am a hacker because deep down I know that I have never installed hacks on to my computer and I have nothing to hide. That being said, I would be more than happy to speak to staff about what has happened to me and hopefully you will realise that you have made a mistake. I would like to repeat that I am not angry with the staff but I just want this to get sorted out. 

Alex (Dr_Octagon/ 4lextr)
